entities.name: EAP message
entities.description: Information element included in SERVICE ACCEPT message when sent to a UE registered for emergency services, used to convey EAP-failure message.

entities.name: SERVICE ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message that may contain the EAP message IE when sent to a UE registered for emergency services.

entities.name: UE registered for emergency services
entities.description: Condition where the UE is registered for emergency services, which triggers the inclusion of the EAP message IE in SERVICE ACCEPT.

entities.name: EAP-failure message
entities.description: EAP message conveyed within the EAP message IE in SERVICE ACCEPT.

relations.description: SERVICE ACCEPT message contains the EAP message IE when sent to a UE registered for emergency services.
Inclusion of EAP message IE in SERVICE ACCEPT is guarded by the condition that the UE is registered for emergency services.
EAP message IE conveys the EAP-failure message.
